sources.title: Dev.java — Using Records to Model Immutable Data

coverage.assessedAt: Quiz 1 + 4; Hash Contract Ambush invalid fixture test

coverage.taughtAt: Identity vs equality and Object contract
coverage.evidenceExpected: reflexive, symmetric, transitive and equal-hash assertions on all generated cases

coverage.taughtAt: HashMap/HashSet key lookup and independent cardinality oracle
coverage.evidenceExpected: map/set unique-key sizes agree with independently derived expected set

coverage.taughtAt: Hash contract failure mode and deliberate defect experiment
coverage.evidenceExpected: a deterministic equal-but-different-hash fixture causes targeted failure, then fix restores green

coverage.taughtAt: Object boundaries through HashMap/HashSet failure modes and guided practice
coverage.evidenceExpected: three immutable domain value objects, 10,000+ generated keys, valid cardinality, mutation impossibility and detected defect
